title: Estimator
description:
Estimator - Construction

Location: Sheffield (with occasional travel to surrounding sites)
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: Up to Â£55k
Additional: Car allowance and company benefits scheme


About the Role

Our client, a construction specialist in both design and build, are seeking an experienced Estimator to join their growing construction team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong background in refurbishment works and new-build commercial projects. You will play a key role in preparing accurate tenders, developing cost plans, and supporting the delivery of successful projects across South Yorkshire and the surrounding regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review tender documentation including drawings, specifications, and project details.
  • Tender for projects of varying values, from receipt of tender packages through to full bills of quantities.
  • Produce logical, consistent pricing schedules and detailed cost breakdowns.
  • Meet subcontractors on site to source labour, plant, and material rates while negotiating competitive quotations.
  • Attend weekly site meetings and carry out site visits as required.
  • Work closely with project management, site teams, design staff, and procurement to ensure accurate and coordinated tender submissions.
  • Maintain high levels of accuracy and attention to detail while working to tight deadlines.
  • Work primarily from the office in a supportive, collaborative team environment.

About You

  • Previous experience reviewing tender documentation, drawings, and specifications.
  • Background in refurbishment work and new-build commercial projects.
  • Prior experience of working within refurbishment on NHS / hospital projects would be advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of construction processes and on-site requirements.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Excel; knowledge of Causeway software is advantageous but not essential.
  • Full UK driving licence.
  • Relevant construction industry experience in an estimating or similar role.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills with the ability to build positive supplier relationships.

Benefits

  • Salary up to Â£55k dependent on experience
  • Vehicle allowance or company car
  • iPhone (or similar device)
  • Bonus percentage per contract awarded
  • 22 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Pension scheme
  • One day per week working from home (by mutual agreement)

The company is looking to arrange interviews quickly for the right candidate so if you feel you could be well suited, please apply with an updated CV or contact Rich at Linsco for further information.

Applications

If you feel that you have the relevant experience to be successful in this position and would like to find out more, please apply online today, attaching a copy of your current CV.

Due to the vast number of applications that we receive, it is not possible for us to contact all applicants; therefore, only suitable candidates will be contacted. If you do not hear anything back within 7 days of submitting your application, you have unfortunately not been selected.

Linsco is an equal opportunities employer. All applicants will be considered on their merits regardless of background, characteristics or personal circumstances. All applications will be dealt with in the strictest confidence.
